progress_and_boundary.arithmetic_boundary: deck size, pile sizes, word weights, rotations, and partition numbers have no intrinsic rational-prime or prime-power semantics
progress_and_boundary.noninvertible_boundary: T_N is not globally invertible in general, so reflection reversal is asserted only on the recurrent core
progress_and_boundary.operator_boundary: the full Koopman map is finite and nonunitary; its recurrent unitary restriction is only a formal operator hint and no Hilbert--Polya claim
progress_and_boundary.progress: one all-N theorem package closes the periodic core, every fixed iterate, primitive cycles, full finite zeta, algebraic Koopman spectrum, recurrent reflection reversal, and triangular family
progress_and_boundary.proof_boundary: Brandt's all-N recurrent characterization is imported with attribution; the finite census regression-tests consequences rather than proving it
progress_and_boundary.transient_boundary: complete transient functional trees, exact hitting-time distributions, and nilpotent Jordan block sizes are outside the claim

source_lock.allowed_data: integer partitions, binary words, rotations, reflections, exact divisor sums, and partition numbers
source_lock.clock: one Bulgarian move: remove one card from every pile and form a new pile from the removed cards
source_lock.cutoff: all-N attributed recurrent theorem; exact finite regression only for 1<=N<=40
source_lock.determinant_convention: Artin--Mazur zeta of the full finite map and reciprocal det(I-z U_N)
source_lock.family: every integer N>=1, uniquely N=binom(k,2)+r with 0<=r<k
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya operators, and Route-B inputs
source_lock.measure: counting measure on P(N), and counting measure on the recurrent subset
source_lock.object: noninvertible Bulgarian-solitaire map T_N on the integer partitions P(N)
source_lock.operator: full finite Koopman pullback U_N f=f composed with T_N and its recurrent permutation restriction
source_lock.phase_space: the full finite partition set P(N), with the Brandt recurrent subset marked inside it
source_lock.recurrent_model: length-k weight-r binary words; w maps to positive parts of (k-1,k-2,...,0)+w
source_lock.rotation_convention: T_N corresponds to right rotation rho(w)_i=w_(i-1 mod k)

theorem.decomposition: every N>=1 has unique N=binom(k,2)+r with integers k>=2 and 0<=r<k
theorem.exact_period: for every d|k, P_d=sum_(e|d) mu(d/e) Fix(T_N^e) and C_d=P_d/d
theorem.fixed_count: with g=gcd(k,t), Fix(T_N^t)=binom(g,r*g/k) if k/g divides r and is zero otherwise
theorem.koopman: det(I-z U_N)=product_(d|k)(1-z^d)^(C_d); zero has algebraic multiplicity p(N)-binom(k,r), and mult(exp(2*pi*i*j/k))=sum_(d|k,k|j*d) C_d
theorem.recurrent_bijection: Brandt recurrent partitions are exactly phi(w)=positive parts of (k-1,...,0)+w for length-k weight-r binary words, and T_N phi=phi rho
theorem.reversor: on the recurrent core Q(w)_i=w_(-i mod k) is an involution with Q rho Q=rho^(-1); rho^a Q gives k phase-labelled reflection formulas, not necessarily distinct on a nonfaithful weight layer
theorem.triangular_boundary: if r=0 the recurrent core is the single staircase (k-1,...,1), with zeta (1-z)^(-1) and recurrent Koopman eigenvalue one
theorem.zeta: zeta_T(z)=product_(d|k)(1-z^d)^(-C_d) for the full noninvertible finite map
